sections.title: Chemical and Biomolecular Fourth Year Seminar
sections.description: This is a required course for CBE PhD candidates in their fourth year and covers topics related to chemical and biomolecular engineering and the PhD level graduate studies. The goal is to present to the committee and their peers in advance of the fifth year dissertation defense.
